verdict: No paid ads running; organic is the only active channel and it's slipping.
narrative: This period, your practice received zero leads from paid advertising — Meta and Google have had no spend for over 45 days, leaving organic search and your Google Business Profile as the sole sources of new patient interest. Your Google Business Profile delivered 142 actions in the last 28 days, including 63 calls and 53 direction requests, but that activity dropped 34% in the most recent week, and the profile recorded zero actions on three of the last four days. Instagram reach has effectively gone dark, generating a total reach of just 8 over the full 28-day window. To stabilize the Google Business Profile and restore social presence, posting activity is being increased immediately, and a paid campaign restart is being prioritized before the engagement close date at month-end.

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile actions fell to zero on three of the last four days, putting the 28-day call and direction volume at risk.
